# Austin Spraggins | Senior Product Engineer & LineCrush CTO

> Austin builds full-stack products, native mobile apps, and applied AI systems. He started LineCrush's codebase and built the product with his co-founder Jay. He started both native LineCrush apps from scratch, wrote their first month of code, and owns releases and store review. The fleet he designed has written most of their feature code since. He built SureWord's apps himself. He is Co-Founder and CTO at LineCrush Inc in Fresno, California.

## Current Work

### LineCrush

Austin architects a production sports research and analytics platform spanning:

- AI-written research reports and product explanations
- Real-time signal search across sports interviews, podcasts, news, and social context
- Vision/OCR analysis of uploaded screenshots and shareable reports
- Automated grading, reporting, notifications, and data-production pipelines
- A Next.js web application, native SwiftUI iOS app, native Kotlin/Compose Android app, and browser extensions
- PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets, Python services, AWS, Vercel, and Ubuntu infrastructure

Verified repository-scale indicators as of 2026-11-18 (source of truth: src/lib/stats.ts). These describe the platform, including work by Jay and the engineering fleet:

- 43,649 commits across the production monorepo (26,369 in 2026)
- ~2,300 tracked TSX modules
- 725 tracked Next.js API handlers
- 70 tracked agent-skill definitions
- Agent fleet ledger since June 23, 2026: 14,111 completed fleet jobs (91% of those admitted), 10,745 completed jobs with a recorded commit link (measured 2026-11-17)

### Autonomous Engineering Agents

Austin built a provider-neutral software-delivery system around Codex and Claude. It uses C2 to move tracker issues through investigation, implementation, real product-path proof, code review, safety gates, and release. Durable sessions recover interrupted work rather than restarting from zero.

The surrounding agent platform includes:

- Shared skills, commands, repository maps, and operating rules
- Custom MCP tooling and cross-platform engineering lanes
- Model routing, fallbacks, recovery, and evidence-backed closeout
- Web, Python, SwiftUI, Kotlin, infrastructure, and release workflows

### Product AI

Austin uses OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and vision/OCR workflows for different jobs rather than treating one model as a universal answer. Production systems include structured prompting, response parsing, streaming, retries, fallbacks, evaluation, and product-level quality gates.

### LineCrush Games

Austin runs an AI-native game studio (games.linecrush.com - "Small crew. Massive games.") with his co-founder Jay in Fresno, CA.

- **Gunmetal Orbit** is the flagship: a space-mining arena roguelite where you pilot exosuits with 6 auto-firing weapon slots from a 28-weapon arsenal, mine ore between enemy waves, bank it at the dock, and snowball your build
- Gunmetal Orbit released on Steam September 10, 2026 at $4.99 - buy at https://store.steampowered.com/app/4975430
- Austin designed and developed Gunmetal Orbit in Godot 4.7 for the Steam Deck's 1280×800 screen and shipped it to Steam 67 days after the first playable build. The paid release supports Windows, Linux, and Apple silicon Macs, with 34 Steam achievements and Steam Cloud.
- Other original titles in development: Space Miner (the predecessor), RockHunter, MERIDIAN, and Last Crew, plus browser party games
- Agents can operate Godot workflows, create and wire scenes, run headless tests, capture playtest evidence, and produce repeatable exports
- Asset pipelines cover generated concepts, rigged 3D models, UI art, and authored AI-assisted audio
- Human product taste owns gameplay feel, art direction, and final acceptance

## Background

Austin moved from truck driving into software, became a web-development instructor at Bitwise Industries and Geekwise Academy, and then co-founded LineCrush. He is a father of two and a hands-on technical leader who can move from product direction to low-level implementation and production proof.

## Independent Public Projects

- LineCrush, SureWord, and Gunmetal Orbit are live products with real users and revenue. LineCrush and SureWord have free and paid plans.
- [SureWord](https://sureword.app): Austin created and shipped this personal Bible study companion across the web, Android (Expo/React Native), and iPhone, iPad and Mac (SwiftUI). It shares one Next.js backend for exact Scripture quotations, offline KJV reading, synchronized study, and user-controlled memory, with a free plan and optional paid Pro.
- [tty7 pull requests](https://www.spragginsdesigns.xyz/work/independent#tty7): Austin has three merged PRs (#694, #877, #1164), four open PRs (#1163, #1165, #1166, #1167), and one open draft (#1174), checked November 19, 2026.
